Stat collection: when on, records action: Stat collection: when on, records action-option generation/selection data (option views only), driving the reports below and the suggestion engine; while off, nothing is recorded and existing history is kept. Automated suggestions: enables the suggestion engine on top of the stats (upweight / downweight / recovery — adjusts weights only, never auto-disables entries), roster planning and AI enhancements; leave off if you only want the reports. Automation depends on stat collection and is unavailable while stats are off. AI attribution: after each option generation, a background AI call matches options semantically to candidate entries, then symmetrically reconciles stats against the local Dice attribution (off by default: one extra API request per generation, and entry content is sent to the model). AI suggestion reasons: natural-language explanations for entries with suggestions in this dimension (triggered on opening the Stats page / switching dimensions, on by default; display only — doesn't change suggestion actions or the write path). Both AI features need a configured API; without one they silently degrade to pure stats.

Stat suggestions write into the pool con: Stat suggestions write into the pool config's weight overrides. After you create a default config, history recorded under the unbound profile merges into it automatically, and suggestions become applicable on the Stats page.

Success/failure tiers scale with how muc: Success/failure tiers scale with how much the margin fills the check space (bigger share → higher tier), each tier with its own direction text; crit success/fail use single entries. Text is injected invisibly as an HTML comment with the player message (visible to the AI, hidden in chat and the input box). The plugin auto-prepends a structured summary (outcome/target/roll/DC/margin/degree) and appends a discipline footer — the template only needs the direction itself; {rate} {roll} {margin} {degree} still work. Empty tier falls back to the outcome fallback text; if both are empty nothing is injected

Sample distribution: current dimension effective pool ${0} Sample coverage of entry – Participation ≥${1} Only the round hit rate is credible (recommendations can be made), and the insufficient ones are marked with "Insufficient Samples". The higher the sufficient percentage, the more credible the optimization suggestions are; "Participation" means that the entry has entered the generation round candidate menu (round co-occurrence), which does not mean that the option must appear in the output. Trends: Generation/selection activity by day (only action options view counts, as dimensions are selected), accumulated since v51, history is not backfilled.
